run_dm_control_explorer: run the DM Control Suite environment explorer with a specified domain and task name
run_explorer_with_action_noise: run the environment explorer with Gaussian action noise applied to each action dimension
run_explorer_without_timeout: run the environment explorer with no episode time limit for unlimited interaction
run_explorer_with_reward_visualization: run the environment explorer with geom colors varying by current reward value
review_prompt_environment_name: review the prompt_environment_name function that interactively validates user input against available environment names
